_comment: Hand-authored recipe list, one serving per entry. Each ingredient is [DOST-FNRI PhilFCT food ID | null, grams per serving (raw/edible portion unless the FNRI row says boiled), label]. scripts/build-recipe-seed.mjs computes nutrition, allergens and diet pattern from the FNRI rows in foods_fnri.csv.

recipes.name: Tapsilog (lean beef tapa, garlic rice, egg)
recipes.steps: Marinate the beef in soy sauce, calamansi and half the garlic. Pan-fry the beef with a little oil. Toast the remaining garlic, stir in the rice, then fry the egg in the same pan. Serve with sliced tomato.

recipes.name: Bangsilog (daing na bangus, garlic rice, egg)
recipes.steps: Marinate the bangus in vinegar, garlic and pepper overnight. Pan-fry skin side down until crisp. Make garlic rice and fry an egg. Serve with tomato.

recipes.name: Arroz caldo with egg
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic, onion and ginger. Add chicken and fish sauce, then the rice and water. Simmer 30 minutes, stirring, until thick. Top with egg, spring onion and calamansi.

recipes.name: Lugaw with egg
recipes.steps: Sauté ginger and garlic, add rice, fish sauce and water. Simmer until creamy. Top with egg and spring onion.

recipes.name: Champorado-lite (less sugar)
recipes.steps: Simmer rice in water until soft. Stir in cocoa and sugar until thick. Serve with a swirl of evaporated milk.

recipes.name: Pandesal with scrambled eggs and tomato
recipes.steps: Scramble the eggs in a little oil with chopped tomato. Fill the pandesal.

recipes.name: Pandesal with peanut butter and banana
recipes.steps: Spread peanut butter on the pandesal and eat with a banana.

recipes.name: Tortang talong with rice
recipes.steps: Grill the eggplant until soft, peel and flatten with a fork. Dip in beaten egg with onion and garlic. Pan-fry both sides. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tuyo with garlic rice and tomato
recipes.steps: Pan-fry the tuyo briefly. Toast garlic in oil and toss in the rice. Serve with tomato and spiced vinegar.

recipes.name: Ginisang itlog na may kamatis with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic, onion and tomato until soft. Pour in beaten eggs and stir gently until just set. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Boiled kamote and eggs
recipes.steps: Boil the kamote until tender and the eggs for 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Ginisang sardinas with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic and onion, add sardines with sauce and the greens. Simmer 3 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Oatmeal with banana and milk
recipes.steps: Cook the oats in milk for 2 minutes. Top with sliced banana and honey.

recipes.name: Mango yoghurt overnight oats
recipes.steps: Mix oats and yoghurt in a jar and chill overnight. Top with mango and honey.

recipes.name: Tokwa scramble on whole-grain toast
recipes.steps: Crumble the tofu and sauté with onion and tomato, season with salt and pepper. Serve on toast.

recipes.name: Banana-oat pancakes
recipes.steps: Blend oats, banana, egg and milk. Cook small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan, 2 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Taho-lite (silken tofu, less arnibal)
recipes.steps: Warm the silken tofu and drizzle with a light brown sugar syrup.

recipes.name: Chicken adobo with rice
recipes.steps: Simmer chicken with soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaf and peppercorns for 30 minutes. Reduce the sauce and brown lightly in oil. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tinolang manok with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté ginger, garlic and onion. Add chicken and fish sauce, then water; simmer 20 minutes. Add papaya until tender, then malunggay. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sinigang na baboy with rice
recipes.steps: Boil pork with tomato and onion until tender. Add tamarind, then radish, eggplant, sitaw and okra. Finish with kangkong and fish sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Sinigang na hipon with rice
recipes.steps: Boil water with tomato, onion and tamarind. Add radish, sitaw and okra; cook 5 minutes. Add shrimp for 3 minutes, then kangkong and fish sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pinakbet with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic, onion, tomato and pork until browned. Add bagoong and a little water, then squash. Add the remaining vegetables and steam until just tender. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Ginisang monggo with malunggay and rice
recipes.steps: Boil mung beans until soft. Sauté garlic, onion and tomato, add the beans and simmer. Stir in malunggay at the end. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken afritada with rice
recipes.steps: Brown the chicken, sauté garlic, onion and tomato. Add tomato paste and water; simmer 20 minutes. Add potato and carrot, then bell pepper. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Nilagang baka with rice
recipes.steps: Simmer beef with onion and peppercorns until tender, skimming the fat. Add corn and potato, then cabbage and pechay. Season with fish sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Paksiw na bangus with rice
recipes.steps: Arrange fish and vegetables in a pan with ginger, garlic, vinegar and a little water. Simmer without stirring for 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Inihaw na tilapia with ensaladang kamatis
recipes.steps: Stuff the tilapia with tomato and onion, wrap and grill 10 minutes per side. Serve with a tomato-onion salad, calamansi and rice.

recipes.name: Ginataang kalabasa at sitaw with hipon
recipes.steps: Simmer squash in coconut milk with garlic and onion until soft. Add sitaw and shrimp and cook 5 minutes. Season with fish sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chop suey with chicken and shrimp
recipes.steps: Stir-fry chicken and shrimp, add the firm vegetables then the leafy ones. Thicken with cornstarch slurry and soy sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pancit bihon with chicken and vegetables
recipes.steps: Soak the bihon. Sauté garlic, onion and chicken, add vegetables, soy sauce and a cup of broth. Toss in the noodles until the liquid is absorbed. Serve with calamansi.

recipes.name: Pancit canton with chicken, shrimp and vegetables
recipes.steps: Stir-fry chicken and shrimp, add vegetables, soy sauce and broth. Add the noodles and toss until cooked.

recipes.name: Ginisang ampalaya with egg and rice
recipes.steps: Salt and rinse the ampalaya to reduce bitterness. Sauté garlic, onion and tomato, add ampalaya for 3 minutes, then the beaten eggs. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Ginisang tokwa at pechay with rice
recipes.steps: Pan-fry cubed tokwa until golden. Sauté garlic and onion, add pechay stems then leaves, return the tofu and season with soy sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Adobong kangkong with tokwa and rice
recipes.steps: Brown the tofu and garlic. Add kangkong stems, soy sauce and vinegar, then the leaves; cook 2 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken inasal with rice and cucumber
recipes.steps: Marinate chicken in calamansi, vinegar, lemongrass and garlic for at least an hour. Grill, basting with annatto oil. Serve with rice and cucumber.

recipes.name: Adobong pusit with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic, onion and tomato. Add squid, soy sauce and vinegar; simmer 5 minutes only so it stays tender. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Bistek tagalog with rice
recipes.steps: Marinate beef in soy sauce and calamansi. Sear quickly, then simmer in the marinade. Top with onion rings softened in the pan. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pork menudo with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic, onion and pork. Add soy sauce, tomato and tomato paste with water; simmer 25 minutes. Add liver, potato, carrot and bell pepper until tender. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Ginataang langka with rice
recipes.steps: Boil jackfruit until tender. Sauté garlic, onion and ginger, add coconut milk, jackfruit and the cooked mung beans. Simmer until creamy. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pritong galunggong with kamatis and rice
recipes.steps: Salt the fish and pan-fry in a little oil until crisp. Serve with tomato-onion salad, spiced vinegar and rice.

recipes.name: Ginisang upo with hipon and rice
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic, onion and tomato, add shrimp, then upo and a splash of water. Cook until the upo is translucent. Season with fish sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken sopas
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic and onion, add chicken and water; boil. Add macaroni and carrot until cooked, then cabbage and evaporated milk. Simmer 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Ginisang sayote with chicken and rice
recipes.steps: Sauté garlic, onion, tomato and chicken. Add sayote strips and a little water; cook until tender. Season with fish sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Kare-kare (lean beef) with rice
recipes.steps: Simmer beef until tender. Sauté garlic and onion in annatto oil, add broth, peanut butter and rice flour to thicken. Add beef and vegetables. Serve with a little bagoong and rice.

recipes.name: Ginisang togue at tokwa with rice
recipes.steps: Brown the tofu. Sauté garlic, onion and carrot, add togue and tofu with soy sauce; cook 2 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tinolang tahong with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté ginger, garlic and onion. Add water and papaya; simmer 10 minutes. Add mussels until the shells open, then malunggay. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Bangus sisig with rice
recipes.steps: Grill and flake the bangus. Sauté onion and chili, add the fish, soy sauce and calamansi; toss until crisp at the edges. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Grilled chicken breast, rice and vegetables
recipes.steps: Season and grill the chicken. Steam carrot and cauliflower and toss with a little oil. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tuna-tomato spaghetti
recipes.steps: Cook the pasta. Sauté garlic, onion and tomato, add tomato paste and tuna, and simmer 5 minutes. Toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Chickpea and vegetable curry with rice
recipes.steps: Sauté onion, garlic and curry powder, add tomato, potato and carrot with water. When tender add chickpeas and coconut milk. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Red bean and rice bowl with avocado
recipes.steps: Warm the beans with onion and a pinch of cumin. Serve over rice with tomato, lettuce, avocado and calamansi.

recipes.name: Baked tilapia with potatoes and carrots
recipes.steps: Toss potato and carrot with oil and roast 15 minutes. Add the seasoned fish and roast 12 minutes more. Finish with calamansi.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with vegetables
recipes.steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside. Stir-fry carrot and cabbage, add rice and soy sauce, then fold in the eggs and spring onion.

recipes.name: Beef and bell pepper stir-fry with rice
recipes.steps: Coat the beef in soy sauce and cornstarch. Stir-fry on high heat, add onion and bell pepper for 2 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken, avocado and tomato rice bowl
recipes.steps: Grill the chicken and slice. Arrange over rice with avocado, tomato and cucumber; squeeze calamansi over.

recipes.name: Tuna and avocado sandwich
recipes.steps: Mash the avocado with the tuna and a squeeze of calamansi. Fill the bread with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Nilagang saging na saba
recipes.steps: Boil the saba in its peel for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Nilagang kamote
recipes.steps: Boil the kamote until a fork slides in easily.

recipes.name: Nilagang mais
recipes.steps: Boil the corn for 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Roasted mani (peanuts)
recipes.steps: A small handful of plain roasted peanuts.

recipes.name: Hard-boiled egg and cucumber
recipes.steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes. Serve with cucumber sticks.

recipes.name: Mango with yoghurt
recipes.steps: Top the yoghurt with diced mango.

recipes.name: Papaya, pineapple and pakwan fruit cup
recipes.steps: Cube the fruit and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Banana with peanut butter
recipes.steps: Slice the banana and dip in peanut butter.

recipes.name: Milk and pandesal
recipes.steps: A glass of milk with one pandesal.
